title: Northgate Tire Center Tread Measurement and Treadwear Standards
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Tread Depth and Treadwear Standards

Tread on a Northgate Tire Center work order is measured in 32nds of an inch at the **shallowest main groove** of the tire. The figures below set the tread depth of a new tire of the class, the depth at which a tire counts as worn out, and the terms on which the Tire Center processes the manufacturer's treadwear mileage warranty.

## Tread depths (32nds of an inch)

| Package | New tire tread depth | Coverage-end tread depth (worn out; no road hazard protection at or below) | Treadwear claim tread depth (qualifies at or below) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | 10 | 2 | 2 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | 10 | 2 | 2 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | 14 | 2 | 2 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | 10 | 2 | 2 |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | 10 | 2 | 2 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | 14 | 2 | 2 |

The new-tire depth is the depth used to measure wear: light truck tires start from 14/32 inch, passenger tires from 10/32 inch.

## Treadwear warranty terms

| Package | Treadwear claims processed | Largest rotation gap allowed for a claim (miles) | Treadwear proration | Replacement tire price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | yes | 7500 | by miles remaining on the manufacturer's warranty | current regular in-club price |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | yes | 7500 | by miles remaining on the manufacturer's warranty | current regular in-club price |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | yes | 7500 | by miles remaining on the manufacturer's warranty | current regular in-club price |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 7500 | by miles remaining on the manufacturer's warranty | current regular in-club price |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | yes | 7500 | by miles remaining on the manufacturer's warranty | current regular in-club price |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 7500 | by miles remaining on the manufacturer's warranty | current regular in-club price |

## Measurement notes

- **Worked reading (hypothetical tire):** a passenger tire measured at 6/32 inch has used 4 of its 8 usable 32nds (new depth 10 less coverage-end depth 2), which is 50 percent of its usable tread.
- A tire measured at exactly 2/32 inch is at the coverage-end depth (worn out) and at the treadwear claim depth; a tire measured at 3/32 inch is above both.
- The 7500-mile figure is the largest gap in miles allowed between installation, the recorded rotations and the claim visit.
